sentences.text:
This application coming on for admission this day, the c  following:
 ORDER

This is the first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.94/2022, registered at Police Station-GRP Rewa Chowki Rewa (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 354, 307, 376, 511, 354-Ka of IPC.
Learned counsel appearing for applicant submitted that applicant is innocent and falsely been implicated.
Investigation is complete and charge sheet has been filed.

In these circumstances,
applicant be released on bail.

3. Learned Government Advocate appearing for the State opposed the application for grant of bail and submitted that applicant had attempted to commit rape with the prosecutrix and thereafter pushed her out of the train.
Considering the aforesaid circumstance, application be dismissed.
